dimensions.assessment: Affects municipal agencies, tribal entities, academic institutions, community groups, and nongovernmental organizations eligible for program assistance and grants.
dimensions.evidence: eligible entity shall submit to the Director an application... Tribal, State, or municipal agency; a nongovernmental organization; a community group; and an academic institution.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a voluntary conservation and grant program with a relatively modest authorized funding level of $200,000 annually.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Director to carry out this section $200,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2033.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes $200,000 in federal appropriations for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2033.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Director to carry out this section $200,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2033.

dimensions.assessment: Gives statutory backing to the Urban Bird Treaty Program and sets up structured grant administration rules with the National Fish and Wildlife Foundation.
dimensions.evidence: This bill provides statutory authority for the Urban Bird Treaty Program, which is administered by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations through fiscal year 2033 for the program.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2033

missing_information: Expected long-term ecological or economic outcomes beyond the authorization of appropriations.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill provides statutory authority for the Urban Bird Treaty Program within the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, authorizes a competitive grant program administered through the National Fish and Wildlife Foundation, and authorizes appropriations of $200,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2033.
